```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(plotly)
source("data.R")
```

## Row {height="18%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste0("Latest full year (", latest$Year, ")")

list(
  icon = "thermometer-half",
  color = "warning",
  value = paste0(sprintf("%+.2f", latest$Anomaly), " °C"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr paste0("Warmest year on record (", warmest$Year, ")")

list(
  icon = "thermometer-high",
  color = "danger",
  value = paste0(sprintf("%+.2f", warmest$Anomaly), " °C"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Years of data"

list(
  icon = "calendar3",
  color = "primary",
  value = nrow(annual_df))
```

## Row {.tabset height="47%"}

```{r}
#| title: "1. Basic line chart"

plot_ly(
  annual_df,
  x = ~Year,
  y = ~Anomaly,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Global Temperature Anomalies Over Time",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature Anomaly (°C)"))
```

```{r}
#| title: "2. Styled line chart"

plot_ly(
  annual_df,
  x = ~Year,
  y = ~Anomaly,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "blue")
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "Global Temperature Anomalies (1880–Present)",
      x = 0.5
    ),
    font = list(family = "Arial", size = 13, color = "#222222"),
    plot_bgcolor = "white",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      showgrid = TRUE,
      gridcolor = "grey"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Temperature Anomaly (°C)",
      showgrid = TRUE,
      gridcolor = "grey",
      zeroline = TRUE,
      zerolinecolor = "black"
    ))
```

```{r}
#| title: "3. Annual vs. 5-year average"

plot_ly(annual_df, x = ~Year) |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~Anomaly,
    name = "Annual Temperature Anomaly",
    line = list(color = "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45)", width = 1.5)
  ) |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~Rolling,
    name = "5-Year Rolling Average",
    line = list(color = "red", width = 3)
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Global Temperature Trends: Annual vs. 5-Year Average",
    xaxis = list(title = "Year", gridcolor = "grey"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature Anomaly (°C)", gridcolor = "grey"),
    plot_bgcolor = "white",
    hovermode = "x unified",
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.12))
```

## Row {height="35%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Monthly anomalies by year (press play)"

plot_ly(
  data = monthly_df,
  x = ~Month,
  y = ~Anomaly,
  frame = ~Year,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(
    size = 10,
    color = ~Anomaly,
    colorscale = "RdBu",
    reversescale = TRUE, # same as RdBu_r in Plotly Express
    cmin = -1.5,
    cmax = 1.5,
    colorbar = list(title = "Anomaly (°C)")
  ),
  text = ~paste0(Month, " ", Year, ": ", sprintf("%.2f", Anomaly), " °C"),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    plot_bgcolor = "white",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Month",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = months,
      gridcolor = "grey"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Temperature Anomaly (°C)",
      range = c(-1.5, 1.5),
      gridcolor = "grey"
    )
  ) |>
  animation_opts(frame = 500, transition = 300, redraw = FALSE) |>
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: "))
```
